derivation: from H7768 (שָׁוַע) in the original sense of freedom;
def: a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo

occurrences.text: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
